name: B7Chat
author: b7kairat

sections.description:
B7Chat is a powerful live chat for your website. Registration and setup directly in the WordPress admin panel.

Key Features:

  • 🚀 Quick registration via the plugin — create a B7Chat account without leaving the admin panel
  • 📱 Responsive design — looks great on all devices
  • 🎨 Customizable appearance — change colors to match your brand
  • 🔄 Draggable widget — visitors can move the widget around the screen
  • 💾 Remembers position — the widget stays where users place it
  • 📊 Analytics — track visitor activity (Pro version)

Why B7Chat?

B7Chat is built for those who value simplicity and functionality. Our chat runs via iframe, does not slow down your site, and requires no technical knowledge to configure.

External Services

This plugin connects to the B7Chat service to provide live chat functionality.

What data is sent and when?

  • When a user logs in or registers via the plugin settings: email address, password, and site URL are sent to the B7Chat API.
  • When the chat widget is displayed on the frontend: the widget key is sent to identify the account.

B7Chat Service

  • Purpose: Provides live chat widget functionality for your website.
  • Terms of Service: https://b7chat.com/user_agreement
  • Privacy Policy: https://b7chat.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to WordPress (Plugins → Add New → Upload)
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → B7Chat
  4. Register or log into an existing account
  5. The chat will automatically appear on your site
sections.faq:
Do I need to register on a separate website?

Yes, a B7Chat account is required for the chat to work. However, you can register directly from the WordPress admin panel without going to an external site.

Can I get the widget without registering?

Yes, if you already have a B7Chat widget_key, you can enter it manually in the plugin settings.

Does the chat work on mobile devices?

Yes, the widget is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.

How do I change the widget color?

Colors are adjusted in your B7Chat personal account after registration.
